decision: Implement from a clean origin/main worktree
why: The primary checkout contains unrelated user changes

decision: Use a nested versioned isolated binding without root targetId
why: Older binaries require root targetId and must fail closed
evidence: Solution Gate S6 and serde legacy shape
result: New loader accepts legacy and isolated v1

decision: Reserve context disposal for explicit user close
why: Daemon restarts and internal shutdown must preserve external Chrome contexts
evidence: Chrome probe and current shared close helpers
result: Internal cleanup detaches; handle_close disposes owned contexts

decision: Treat two parallel suite failures as baseline env contamination
why: Both failures read AGENT_BROWSER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS from process-global state and pass independently with one test thread
evidence: cargo test plus two isolated serial reruns
result: Use serial full suite for final verification

decision: Dispose a newly created isolated context only until its binding persists
why: Attach failures must not orphan new contexts, while later command failures must not destroy a durable session context
result: Successful binding persistence transfers lifecycle ownership to the session

decision: Dispose an active recording child context during internal daemon shutdown
why: Only the primary context is persisted; a recording task cannot be resumed by the replacement daemon
result: Daemon restart preserves primary context but cleans non-resumable recording context

decision: Centralize child-context cleanup across every internal daemon exit
why: Signal and idle shutdown bypass the internal restart command; partial recording setup may register a child before RecordingState owns its id
evidence: cli/src/native/daemon.rs shutdown branches and Review Gate lifecycle audit
result: All internal exits clean registered child contexts before saving the primary context
